descriptions.text: Enchanted Auto Buckler of the Peach Pit. Forms a metallic buckler on command. May be triggered via hotlist or by shaking your wrist like you're thinking of your hot Aunt Lydia. This item is enchanted with Shatter. Any attack that lands upon this shield has a 1.5% chance to disarm the opponent. If the opponent is disarmed, there is a 90% chance the item will drop to the ground, a 5% chance the weapon will break, and a 5% chance the weapon will be immediately transferred to your own inventory.

recap.text: Katia's fan box gives her a riot shield, but the system will not let her wear it alongside the bracer on her left wrist. She hands the bracer to Carl, who had forgotten she owned it. It looks like the bracer on his right wrist, and he slides it on over his jacket sleeve. A twist pops out a small shield, a shake makes it vanish, and Donut calls it much better than a litterbox.

Carl is sure the gerbils are a punishment, since they keep coming while the town's defenders fall. He tosses a smoke curtain and a pair of hob-lobbers, steps over the barricade, and wades toward the street while Donut yells after him. He extends his left-arm shield and the auto-buckler catches a flying gerbil, which falls hard, blinded and dazed. Too tired to fight it, he steps on it.

Carl pulls a short black forearm bracer covered in little buckles from his boxes: the Enchanted Right Back Atcha Personal Shield, an overly enthusiastic auto buckler that catches bolt attacks and can throw them back. The Peach Pit's disarm chance has never once worked for him, and Mordecai calls the new bracer much better. Carl tosses the old one onto the pile for the Faction Wars team.

beats.headline: Much better than a litterbox
beats.text: Katia's fan box gives her a riot shield, and when she tries to equip it the system will not let her wear both. So she takes a bracer off her left wrist and tells Carl to have it; he needs a shield anyway. He had forgotten she owned it. She mostly used it to add to her mass. It looks like the bracer on his right wrist, the one that forms his gauntlet. He slides it on over the arm of his jacket and experiments: a twist of the wrist and a small shield pops into place, a shake and it disappears. Much better than a litterbox, says Donut.
beats.gist: Katia gives Carl her spare bracer, a shield that pops out with a wrist twist.

beats.headline: A gerbil, caught
beats.text: The gerbils will not stop coming, the town's defenders are falling, and Carl is sure this is a punishment. He tosses a smoke curtain and a pair of hob-lobbers, steps over the barricade and wades out toward the street while Donut yells after him, and extends his left-arm shield. He catches a flying gerbil with the auto-buckler. It falls hard to the ground, blinded and dazed. Too tired to fight it any more, he steps on it.
beats.gist: Carl, sure the gerbils are a punishment, catches one with his auto-buckler and stomps it.

beats.headline: Swapped for a pushier shield
beats.text: A short black forearm bracer covered in little buckles comes out of Carl's boxes: the Enchanted Right Back Atcha Personal Shield, an overly enthusiastic auto buckler that catches physical and magical bolt attacks and can throw them back. He already wears two bracers, and the Peach Pit's disarm chance has never once worked for him. Mordecai calls the new one much better, and it matches his other bracer. Carl pulls the Enchanted Auto Buckler of the Peach Pit off his left arm and tosses it onto their growing pile of weapons and armour for the Faction Wars team.
beats.gist: Carl swaps his Peach Pit buckler for the Right Back Atcha shield and discards the old one.
